verdict.rationale: Unreal documents a full headless and CI automation toolchain. The Unreal Automation Tool automates testing and building, and a single command can cook, package, deploy and run a project. Commandlet invocations like `UnrealEditor.exe <uproject> -run=cook -targetplatform=...` and startup command-line arguments cover scripted runs. Dedicated servers run headlessly without rendering, the Automation Test Framework runs smoke tests when commandlets start, and Gauntlet orchestrates multi-process test sessions. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of unattended/no-render editor flags or a guide for integrating with a CI system, and independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
